You asked: On the settings page of the habit tracker, add a Dark mode switch. It should remember my choice.
App name: Habit tracker
Summary: Adds a Dark mode switch to the settings page. The page turns dark when it is on, and the choice is remembered.
The plan has 1 feature: “Dark mode switch on the settings page”.
“Dark mode switch on the settings page” (id: dark-mode): As a user I can switch the app to dark colours on the settings page, and it stays that way when I come back.
Check for “Dark mode switch on the settings page”: The settings page shows a switch labelled Dark mode, and it is off by default.
Check for “Dark mode switch on the settings page”: Turning the switch on makes the page background dark.
Check for “Dark mode switch on the settings page”: Turning the switch off makes the page background light again.
Check for “Dark mode switch on the settings page”: After the switch is turned on and the page is reloaded, the switch is still on and the page is dark.
Check for “Dark mode switch on the settings page”: After the switch is turned off and the page is reloaded, the switch is off and the page is light.
Choice made for you: The switch is off until the person turns it on, and the choice is kept for that person on the same device.
Name the tests and the code must agree on: The switch is on the settings page and its label is Dark mode.
Name the tests and the code must agree on: The switch has the test id dark-mode-switch.
